description: PAID $0.005 USDC. Base token scam check: verdict go / caution / avoid, honeypot / cannot-sell, mintable, buy/sell tax and a 0-100 risk score. No charge if the scan fails. Example: address=0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913. Cached scan, else live on-chain scan with swap simulation (about 3-8 s). Returns JSON verdict go, caution, or avoid, honeypot and tax flags, and a 0-100 risk score for the Base token.

address.description: Base token contract. Format: 0x followed by 40 hex characters. Example: 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913. Required.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].
